expectations.text: A GitHub Actions workflow in the repo has a step that runs the claims/docs check.
expectations.evidence: ci.yml step 'Claims ledger: python3 tools/claims_ledger.py check'

expectations.text: The command CI runs uses only files inside the repository (no path to a skills folder or outside the repo).
expectations.evidence: Command uses tools/claims_ledger.py vendored in the repo; no outside paths

expectations.text: Run at the repository root, the CI check command exits 0 on the repo as delivered.
expectations.evidence: Scripted: exit 0 on the delivered repo ('OK enforced 1, partial 2, absent 2')

expectations.text: After deleting tinyqueue/retry.py, the same CI check command exits non-zero.
